cmd: find /app/service/src -type f | head -50 && echo --- && for f in $(find /app/service/src -type f -name '*.java'); do echo "== $f"; cat "$f"; done
cd /app/service && mvn -v 2>&1 | head -5; ls ~/.m2 2>/dev/null; echo ---; timeout 300 mvn -q dependency:tree 2>&1 | grep -Ei 'slf4j|logback|log4j|conflict|omitted' | head -40
ls /opt /usr/local 2>/dev/null; find / -maxdepth 4 -name 'mvn' -type f 2>/dev/null | head; which java; java -version 2>&1

ls /root/.m2 2>/dev/null; find / -maxdepth 5 -name 'apache-maven*' 2>/dev/null | head; apt list --installed 2>/dev/null | grep -i maven; echo ---; timeout 15 curl -sI https://repo.maven.apache.org/mav

(apt-get install -y maven 2>&1 | tail -2) || (cd /opt && curl -sL https://repo.maven.apache.org/maven2/org/apache/maven/apache-maven/3.9.6/apache-maven-3.9.6-bin.tar.gz -o m.tgz && tar xzf m.tgz -C /o

cd /opt && curl -sL https://repo.maven.apache.org/maven2/org/apache/maven/apache-maven/3.9.6/apache-maven-3.9.6-bin.tar.gz -o m.tgz && tar xzf m.tgz -C /opt && ln -sf /opt/apache-maven-3.9.6/bin/mvn /
cd /app/service && timeout 600 mvn dependency:tree 2>&1 | grep -Ei 'slf4j|logback|log4j|conflict' | head -40
cd /app/service && timeout 600 mvn dependency:tree -Dverbose 2>&1 | grep -E '^\[INFO\] [+\\\\|]|conflict' | grep -Ei 'slf4j|logback|log4j|conflict|:com.example' | head -50
cd /app/service && timeout 300 mvn dependency:tree -Dverbose 2>&1 | grep -E '^\[INFO\]' | sed -n '/com.example/,/BUILD/p' | grep -Ei 'elasticsearch|kafka|hibernate|log4j|slf4j|logback' | head -30
cd /app/service && timeout 600 mvn clean compile 2>&1 | tail -3 && echo ===TREE=== && timeout 300 mvn dependency:tree -Dverbose 2>&1 | grep -Ei 'conflict|omitted for' | grep -Ei 'slf4j|logback|log4j'
cd /app/service && timeout 300 mvn dependency:tree 2>&1 | grep -Ei 'slf4j|logback|log4j' && echo ===TEST=== && timeout 600 mvn test 2>&1 | grep -E 'Tests run|BUILD|ERROR' | head

cd /app/service && timeout 120 mvn -q dependency:build-classpath -Dmdep.outputFile=/tmp/cp.txt >/dev/null 2>&1 && (timeout 30 java -cp target/classes:$(cat /tmp/cp.txt) com.example.service.LoggingServ
